title: Town Hall Smart Attack starting points
description: Research-guided one-battle settings for every current Home Village Town Hall. Choosing one loads its complete preset-owned settings, explicitly selects the Town Hall Hero loadout, and enables the bounded local Smart Attack policy for the army already trained in game. Recommended army names are guidance only; the bot never edits or retrains that army.

presets.label: Town Hall 2
presets.summary: Smart all-sides deployment; GiArch is the current researched recommendation.
presets.description: Uses the active profile army, selects no Heroes, and spreads along every small-village side. The GiArch name is guidance; no army is silently retrained.
presets.source_note: config/game/smart-attack-strategies.json TH2 policy; community recommendation GiArch.
